# ASCII art

Terminal-inspired simplicity with text-shaped decoration.

## Use

Use for developer learning, technical demos, and playful command-center displays.

## Essential traits

- Monospace structure
- Terminal markers
- Sparse character texture

## Typography

System monospace throughout.

## Layout and surfaces

Terminal alignment, short labels, and bounded character patterns. Green-on-dark panels with decorative text patterns outside content.

## Palette

- background: #081a12
- surface: #10291d
- text: #eaffef
- muted: #b0d7ba
- accent: #99f1b2
- border: #4e8460

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply ASCII art to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace throughout. Terminal alignment, short labels, and bounded character patterns. Green-on-dark panels with decorative text patterns outside content. Palette: background #081a12, surface #10291d, text #eaffef, muted #b0d7ba, accent #99f1b2, border #4e8460. Essential traits: Monospace structure; Terminal markers; Sparse character texture. Avoid: ASCII diagrams replacing precise visuals; Decorative screen-reader noise; Tiny terminal text. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
